Analysis based on the work of Leonidas Lundell with support from Lars Roed 
Ingerslev and myself - see [github repo](href = https://github.com/leonidaslundell/Ontology-Descent/tree/master)

```{r network}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(duckplyr)
library(data.table)
library(igraph)

flatNet <- as.list(GO.db::GOBPCHILDREN)

allNodes <- unique(c(names(flatNet), unlist(flatNet)))
flatNet <- flatNet[!is.na(flatNet)]
onto2eg <- as.list(org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.egGO2ALLEGS)
allNodes <- allNodes[allNodes %in% names(onto2eg)]
flatNet <- flatNet[names(flatNet) %in% allNodes]
flatNet <- reshape2::melt(flatNet)
flatNet <- data.table::as.data.table(flatNet)
colnames(flatNet) <- c("from", "to")
# flatNet <- flatNet |> 
#   dplyr::mutate(from = as.character(from),
#                 to = as.character(to))
flatNet <- flatNet[,c("from", "to"):=.(as.character(from),
                                           as.character(to))]
  
graphNet <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(flatNet)

  #############
  #add the names as a graph attribute
ontoNames <- as.list(GO.db::GOTERM)
ontoNames <- sapply(ontoNames, AnnotationDbi::Term)

igraph::V(graphNet)$ontoTerm <- ontoNames[igraph::V(graphNet)$name]

```

Load in data and run clustering analysis

```{r network analysis}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

target_go_terms <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/Biological_Process.xlsx"))

significant_go_terms <- target_go_terms |> 
  dplyr::filter(FDR<0.05) |> 
  #some terms do not exist in the network for some reason?
  dplyr::filter(ID %in% V(graphNet)$name)

connectedSubgraph <- igraph::all_shortest_paths(graphNet, 
                                                from = significant_go_terms$ID, 
                                                to = significant_go_terms$ID, 
                                                mode = "all")

connectedSubgraph <- connectedSubgraph$res
  connectedSubgraph <- unique(names(unlist(connectedSubgraph)))

  #we check that all(significant_go_terms$ID %in% connectedSubgraph)==TRUE
  
  ontoNetSubgraph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(graphNet, connectedSubgraph)
set.seed(429)
   ontoClustCommunity <- leidenAlg::find_partition(igraph::as.undirected(ontoNetSubgraph),
                                                           edge_weights = rep(1, ecount(ontoNetSubgraph)),
                                                           resolution = .6) +1
   
   
   ontoClust <- data.table::data.table(membership = ontoClustCommunity, names = igraph::V(ontoNetSubgraph)$name)

   clusterTerm <- sapply(unique(ontoClust$membership), function(x){

    x <- ontoClust$names[ontoClust$membership == x]

    xSub <- igraph::induced_subgraph(graphNet, x)
    #directionality is good here...
    set.seed(429)
    xMax <- igraph::centr_eigen(xSub)$vector
    xTerm <- igraph::V(graphNet)$ontoTerm[match(x[which.max(xMax)],
                                                 igraph::V(graphNet)$name)]

   
      return(xTerm)
    
  })

  names(clusterTerm) <- unique(ontoClust$membership)

  #############
  #prepare result table

  ontoClust <- data.frame(clusterNumber = ontoClust$membership,
                          clusterTerm = clusterTerm[as.character(ontoClust$membership)],
                          ontoID = ontoClust$names,
                          ontoTerm = igraph::V(graphNet)$ontoTerm[match(ontoClust$names,
                                                                       igraph::V(graphNet)$name)])

     
```


```{r}

 cols <- ggsci::pal_igv()(max(ontoClust$clusterNumber))
  set.seed(429)
  cols <- sample(cols, max(ontoClust$clusterNumber), replace = F)
  cols <- cols[ontoClust$clusterNumber]
  ontoClust$color <- cols

  ontoClust[!ontoClust$ontoID %in% significant_go_terms$ID, "color"] <- "#808080"

  #cluster name (instead of targeting a specific node, try to make a 2D space of nodes, and put the label in the center of that)

  if(!all(igraph::V(ontoNetSubgraph)$name == ontoClust$ontoID)){stop("wrong order")}

  igraph::vertex_attr(ontoNetSubgraph) <- list(name = ontoClust$ontoID,
                                               color = ontoClust$color,
                                               clusterTerm = ontoClust$clusterTerm,
                                               label.color = ontoClust$color,
                                               ontoTerm = ontoClust$ontoTerm)

  igraph::V(ontoNetSubgraph)$size <- 0
  igraph::V(ontoNetSubgraph)$size[igraph::V(ontoNetSubgraph)$name %in% significant_go_terms$ID] <- 2

  ontoNetSubgraph <- as.undirected(ontoNetSubgraph)

  ontoNetSubgraph <- igraph::add_layout_(ontoNetSubgraph, igraph::nicely(), igraph::component_wise())

  
```

```{r}
#####Ggraph test####
  ggraph(ontoNetSubgraph, layout = "nicely")+
    geom_edge_link0(width = 0.2, colour = "grey") +
    geom_node_point(col = ontoClust$color,
                    aes(fill = ontoClust$clusterTerm), 
                    size = ifelse(ontoClust$color=="#808080", 0,5)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
            values = unique(ontoClust$color),
            labels = unique(ontoClust$clusterTerm),
            name = "cluster",
            guide = "legend"
        )+
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, shape = 21)))+
        theme_graph() +
        theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14)) 
  ```
